delivery_plan_revisions_approval_check.name: delivery_plan_revisions_approval_check
delivery_plan_revisions_approval_check.value: "delivery_plan_revisions"."status" not in ('APPROVED', 'CONSUMED') or "delivery_plan_revisions"."approved_at" is not null

document_conversions_result_success_chec.name: document_conversions_result_success_check
document_conversions_result_success_chec.value: ("document_conversions"."status" = 'SUCCEEDED' and "document_conversions"."markdown_asset_id" is not null) or ("document_conversions"."status" <> 'SUCCEEDED' and "document_conversions"."markdown_asset_id" is null)

narration_plan_revisions_sample_approval.name: narration_plan_revisions_sample_approval_check
narration_plan_revisions_sample_approval.value: "narration_plan_revisions"."status" <> 'APPROVED' or "narration_plan_revisions"."requires_sample_approval" = false or "narration_plan_revisions"."sample_asset_id" is not null

task_runs_result_asset_success_check.name: task_runs_result_asset_success_check
task_runs_result_asset_success_check.value: ("task_runs"."status" = 'SUCCEEDED' and "task_runs"."result_asset_id" is not null) or ("task_runs"."status" <> 'SUCCEEDED' and "task_runs"."result_asset_id" is null)

video_versions_success_payload_check.name: video_versions_success_payload_check
video_versions_success_payload_check.value: ("video_versions"."status" = 'SUCCEEDED' and "video_versions"."asset_id" is not null and "video_versions"."duration_ms" is not null and "video_versions"."qc_report_id" is not null) or ("video_versions"."status" = 'FAILED' and "video_versions"."asset_id" is null and "video_versions"."duration_ms" is null and "video_versions"."qc_report_id" is null)
